title: Design System: DSH AI Providers UI

title.purpose: Settings page and major panel titles.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Host menus, popovers, and floating panels.

narrative.overview: Provider configuration is an Operate-mode interface embedded in DeepSeek Harness. DSH supplies the visual authority; provider identity comes from configuration structure and technical copy rather than a parallel theme.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet, compact, task-first DSH settings surfaces.
Host-owned light and dark themes through semantic aliases.
Shared controls for actions, values, credentials, and persistence.
Provider-specific controls inside a consistent capability structure.

rules.name: Semantic Alias
rules.body: Feature UI uses --dsw-alias-* variables rather than literal theme colors.

rules.name: One Interface Voice
rules.body: The embedded UI uses DSH typography and density, not the documentation site's marketing language.

rules.name: One Edge
rules.body: A surface has either a neutral border or a DSH elevation shadow, never both.

dos: Use DSH primitives and semantic tokens before creating a local control.
Verify light, dark, keyboard, narrow layouts, and long bilingual labels.
Let provider-specific information architecture carry product identity.
donts: Do not import documentation-site geometry or palette into settings.
Do not add literal UI colors or plugin-level light/dark selectors.
Do not leave native buttons unstyled where the shared Button fits.
